scope: Disconnected Icq.setOnlineStatus(32) in original, raw and delivered MIDP2-RU, each in a fresh MicroEmulator process with typed options, memory RMS, real date/persistence/contact-list code. Only OtherAction.<clinit> receives an entry observer, optionally throwing a scripted exception. Its inverse restores all dumped classes/methods/handlers; Icq and all other application/resource bytes are unchanged by the observer. An injected failure demonstrates ordering, not a claim that the original initializer naturally fails. Connected/network paths and full program equivalence are outside this test. Full status methods and exact initial option-save sequence are separately retained for all 15 original/delivered variants.
